name: query_raw
description: Direct access to any sidecar API endpoint with full parameter passthrough and pagination. Use this when no higher-level tool covers your needs, or when you need precise control over query parameters. The endpoint is a path on the local sidecar server (e.g., /api/acled-events). Results are returned as-is from the sidecar.

parameters.params: object (optional) — Key-value query parameters to pass through to the endpoint
parameters.offset: number (optional) — Pagination offset for large result sets
parameters.limit: number (optional) — Maximum number of results to return

examples.description: Fetch recent ACLED conflict events in Ukraine
Get FRED economic data for the federal funds rate
